description: This file contains functions for retrieving and processing MAC addresses from various sources such as device tree, JSON configuration, MTD partitions, and MMC devices. It also includes utility functions for MAC address manipulation and decryption routines specific to certain hardware.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a specified file at a given offset.

methods.name: get_mac_label_dt
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from device tree.

methods.name: get_mac_label_json
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from /etc/board.json.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Attempts to get MAC address label from device tree, falls back to JSON.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device path for a given MTD partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in ASCII form from a partition or data string.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets MAC address in ASCII from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts MAC address from an Arcadyan encrypted MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts MAC address from a Deco encrypted MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Gets MAC address from UCI config in UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads MAC address as text from a specific offset in an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets MAC address in ASCII from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Gets binary MAC address from an MMC partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the NIC part of a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the CID of an MMC device.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the locally administered bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the multicast bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string to canonical form.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled.
